about: Input files some working examples need and AutoMC does not ship. `python -m automc data fetch EXAMPLE` downloads them into the data cache (AUTOMC_DATA_CACHE, else ~/.cache/automc/data) and checks each against its SHA-256; an example's build.py copies what it needs from there into its case.

cad/fuel_pin.h5m.source: the OpenMC notebook 'cad-based-geometry' (its link, Google Drive): a DAGMC fuel pin

cad/teapot.h5m.source: the OpenMC notebook 'cad-based-geometry' (its link, Google Drive): the Utah teapot as a DAGMC model

cad/paramak_with_graveyard.h5m.source: the OpenMC notebook 'cad-based-geometry' (its link, Argonne Box): a Paramak reactor with its graveyard

cad/manifold.h5m.source: the OpenMC notebook 'unstructured-mesh-part-ii' (its link, Argonne Box): a manifold as a DAGMC model

mesh/manifold_mesh.h5m.source: the OpenMC notebook 'unstructured-mesh-part-ii' (its link, Argonne Box): a tetrahedral mesh of the manifold (MOAB)

mesh/pin_mesh_moab.h5m.source: the OpenMC notebook 'unstructured-mesh-part-i' (its link, Argonne Box): a tetrahedral mesh of a pin (MOAB)

mesh/pin_mesh_libmesh.e.source: the OpenMC notebook 'unstructured-mesh-part-i' (its link, Argonne Box): the same pin mesh for libMesh (Exodus); not used here, this OpenMC build has no libMesh

wmp/092238.h5.source: the windowed multipole library of MIT CRPG, release v1.1: U-238

endf/n-001_H_002.endf.source: ENDF/B-VIII.0, NNDC's neutron sublibrary (read from its archive by range requests, about 0.2 MB of 310 MB)

endf/n-064_Gd_157.endf.source: ENDF/B-VIII.0, NNDC's neutron sublibrary (read from its archive by range requests, about 0.6 MB of 310 MB)
